entries.what: Google's sitemaps ping endpoint is gone, and pings get a 404. The post of 2023-06-26 gave it 6 months and now says the deprecation is complete. It names no day, so this date is that post plus 6 months. The post also says a leftover ping does no harm to Google Search: it just does nothing.

source.quote: The sitemaps ping endpoint deprecation is complete.

entries.replacement: Submit sitemaps through robots.txt and Search Console, as the post says.
requires: There is no request to swap in. Remove the ping, and list the sitemap in robots.txt or submit it in Search Console.
